findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_cycle, create_five_forces, create_quadrant_matrix, create_fishbone, create_raci, create_stop_start_continue · Public sink: create_football_field, create_issue_tree, create_quadrant_matrix · Destructive: create_cycle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_cycle, create_five_forces, create_quadrant_matrix, create_fishbone, create_raci, create_stop_start_continue · Public sink: create_football_field, create_issue_tree, create_quadrant_matrix · Destructive: create_cycle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
